I. The Desire for God

27 The desire for God is written in the human heart, because man is created by God and for God.1

28 In many ways, throughout history down to the present day, men have given expression to their quest for God.

The soul of man is naturally religious.

29 This "intimate and vital bond of man to God" can be forgotten, overlooked, or even explicitly rejected by man.

30 "Let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice."

1 Cf. some footnote material
